meta.title: Yanyan Toolkit
meta.description: Yanyan Toolkit is an "install once, get five" umbrella bundle: one install gives you five independently toggleable plugins covering five everyday needs - plugin updates, session organization, subagent cleanup, icon generation, and plugin discovery. One package equips you with a complete set of DSH daily tools. Plugin Update: check and update plugins row by row on the Plugins page, covering both npm and local git/file sources; Session Hub: manage sessions, workspaces and tags in a three-pane layout, with a built-in recycle bin and batch operations so accidental deletions can be restored; Subagent Management: clean up subagents one by one or all at once from the session tab, thoroughly removing leftovers; Icon Generator: upload an image to auto-crop, preview and download a plugin icon, no design tool needed; Find the Right Plugin: registers a tool for the agent to pick "the one plugin you should install" from the entire DSH plugin ecosystem. All five are self-developed, can be toggled independently, and are stable and reliable.
